fitAnalysis.assessment:
This is a WEAK FIT at 38%, since the core search and vector database requirements are missing.

**Strengths:**
- Java plus Kotlin and Spring Boot, running the settlement service
- Cut payment API p99 latency from 480 ms to 120 ms
- Led 4 engineers through a 9 month monolith-to-services migration

**Gaps:**
- No Elasticsearch, Lucene or Solr experience
- No vector search work (HNSW, IVF, vector databases)
- No search relevance or search algorithm design background

**Recommendation:** Build a small Lucene or Elasticsearch vector search project with HNSW, contribute upstream, then apply once you can show it.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad describes a team that needs to make Elasticsearch faster and easier to understand, one reviewed change at a time. I faced a similar problem when payment status reads slowed down at Lumen Payments. I cut p99 latency of the status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis.

I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 11 years of Java and Kotlin behind me, and I know that Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java. At Lumen I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot on Kafka, and I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. That meant technical design, code review and guiding work from start to finish. I haven't worked on search engines or vector search, so I'd come to that area as a fast learner on top of solid data storage, event-driven architecture and debugging experience from on-call work. During my career break I contributed bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library, so GitHub-based collaboration is familiar to me.

Your distributed, asynchronous way of working suits how I like to build software: direct communication and careful review. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can contribute to the Search Relevance team, and I'm available to start talks at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Elastic Hiring Team,

I've spent eleven years writing production Java and Kotlin, most recently leading a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month move from a monolith to 6 services, so I'm used to technical design and code review on shared codebases. I also cut the p99 latency of a payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms, which is the kind of performance work I'd like to bring to Elasticsearch. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a call any weekday and can start within a month of an offer.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

followUpEmail.subject: Following Up: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
followUpEmail.body:

Priya Raman
